name: PinMap
description: A map with one draggable pin for choosing a location: drag, click or nudge it with the arrow keys (Shift moves further). Controlled through `value`; without `onValueChange` it is a read-only preview.
signature: ({ config, value, onValueChange, label, zoom, fallback, radius, onRadiusChange, minRadius, maxRadius, radiusStep, radiusLabel, className, ref, }: PinMapProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: config
props.description: Typed component configuration and external provider definitions.

props.name: fallback
props.description: The area shown when there is no pin: [west, south, east, north]. Default: the world.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the map for assistive tech: "Map of 12 Example Lane".

props.name: maxRadius
props.description: The largest radius the handle allows. Default 10,000 m.

props.name: minRadius
props.description: The smallest radius the handle allows. Default 10 m.

props.name: onRadiusChange
props.description:
Called with the new radius as its handle is dragged or stepped with the keyboard. Adds the
handle; without it the circle is fixed. Keep `radius` controlled, in sync with a field.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called when the pin is dropped, nudged with the arrow keys or placed by a click. Without it
the pin is fixed (a read-only preview).

props.name: radius
props.description:
A circle of this many metres around the pin, such as a geofence, drawn at its true size at
every zoom and moving with the pin. Omit for none.

props.name: radiusLabel
props.description: Names the handle: "Geofence radius". Default "Radius". Its value is read as a distance.

props.name: radiusStep
props.description: The handle's step in metres; Page Up and Down move ten. Default 5 m.

props.name: ref
props.description: The handle for moving the view from outside the map.

props.name: value
props.description: The pin, or null for none yet.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Zoom used to show the pin. Default 16 (a street and its buildings).
